_comment: Hand-written seed records. Unlike from-prod.json these are invented, so edit them freely. IDs are 12 chars from the same alphabet as generated nanoids, but spelled to be readable.

person._comment: For testing a sign-in by someone from another unit. The SES id is what a kiosk scan resolves against.

user._comment: Super user: every location, all admin. No location_grants attribute — a String Set cannot be empty, so it is omitted rather than written empty.
Ordinary user, granted Test Unit only — use this one to check that Other Test Unit is not reachable.
